rows.quote: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.
rows.reason_zh: 两版说明相同，字段变更中也没有 IsBreakable，沿用基础技能不可被破坏的原判。

rows.quote: He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.
rows.reason_zh: 力量仍为食人魔魔法师自身提供法力回复。

rows.quote: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.
rows.reason_zh: 基础施法命中一个敌人，多重施法也只重复命中同一目标，因此范围伤害的否定判定仍成立。

rows.quote: dealing damage and stunning the target.
rows.reason_zh: 命中时仍会眩晕目标。

rows.quote: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍以一个敌方单位为目标。

rows.quote: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames.
rows.reason_zh: 一次基础施法仍可使主目标和另一个随机单位受到燃烧伤害。

rows.quote: The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
rows.reason_zh: 燃烧伤害和持续时间虽有调整，目标仍会被降低移动速度。

rows.quote: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍可指定敌方主目标，另一个受影响的单位才是随机选取的。

rows.quote: causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.
rows.reason_zh: 强化攻击仍附带纯粹伤害和减速，符合攻击特效定义。

rows.quote: When attacking non-hero targets, amount healed is decreased by the standard creep lifesteal factor.
rows.reason_zh: 新增说明只涉及攻击非英雄时的回复量，字段变更中没有 IsBreakable，沿用可被破坏的原判。

rows.quote: Omniknight heals for %heal_pct%%% of the damage dealt over %heal_duration%s.
rows.reason_zh: 全能骑士仍会在一段时间内回复生命，攻击非英雄只会降低回复量。

rows.quote: Omniknight heals for %heal_pct%%% of the damage dealt over %heal_duration%s.
rows.reason_zh: 自身回复量仍按这次攻击造成的伤害计算，符合吸血定义。

rows.quote: slow his target for a short duration.
rows.reason_zh: 强化攻击仍会短暂减速目标。

rows.quote: When attacking non-hero targets, amount healed is decreased by the standard creep lifesteal factor.
rows.reason_zh: 本次新增说明只区分受击目标对应的回复量，施法指向没有变更，沿用可指定敌方单位的原判。

rows.quote: Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast. DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 施法之初仍会对友方目标施加强驱散。

rows.quote: delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends.
rows.reason_zh: 目标受到的伤害仍延至技能结束时结算，符合减伤条目中的延迟结算定义。

rows.quote: delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends.
rows.reason_zh: 致命伤害也会延迟结算，因此目标在效果期间仍可免于被这部分伤害击杀。

rows.quote: Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified.
rows.reason_zh: 技能延迟并放大目标收到的治疗，本身没有独立的生命回复量。

rows.quote: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
rows.reason_zh: 结算会计入目标当时已有的魔抗削减，技能本身没有施加减魔抗或魔法易伤。

rows.quote: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them
rows.reason_zh: 目标仍会被缴械，冷却调整不影响该效果。

rows.quote: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them %magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%% magic damage resistance.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍对指定单位施加效果，本次只调整冷却，沿用可指定敌方单位的原判。

rows.quote: causing them to regenerate health over time.
rows.reason_zh: 初始伤害结算后，目标仍会持续回复生命。

rows.quote: Can be cast on enemies and allies.
rows.reason_zh: 施法时仍可指定一个敌方或友方单位。

rows.quote: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor%
rows.reason_zh: 装备者的攻击仍会降低目标护甲。

rows.quote: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor%, slows their movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 减甲、减速和减疗仍由装备者的普通攻击施加。

rows.quote: reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击仍会削减目标的生命恢复，新增说明仅限定该效果与其他物品的叠加。

rows.quote: slows their movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets)
rows.reason_zh: 攻击仍会降低目标移动速度，新增的叠加限制未移除减速。

rows.quote: Your attacks slow the target's movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 装备者的普通攻击仍附带减速和减疗。

rows.quote: reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 受击目标的生命恢复仍会被削减。

rows.quote: Your attacks slow the target's movement by %slow_ranged%%% (%slow_melee%%% against melee targets)
rows.reason_zh: 攻击仍会降低目标的移动速度。

rows.quote: Passive: Poison Attack Poisons the target hero, dealing %damage% magical damage per second.
rows.reason_zh: 装备者攻击英雄仍可附加持续毒伤，目标限于英雄且幻象攻击不能触发，均未移除装备的攻击特效。

rows.quote: At the end of the silence, %silence_damage_percent%%% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.
rows.reason_zh: 沉默结束时会按期间所受伤害另行造成魔法伤害，说明没有赋予减魔抗或魔法易伤效果。

rows.quote: Active: Soul Burn Silences the target unit for %silence_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 引文仅描述主动效果，两版说明相同且没有回蓝字段变更，沿用装备提供自身回蓝的原判。

rows.quote: Silences the target unit for %silence_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 主动效果仍会使目标沉默。

rows.quote: After teleportation, all enemies in a %radius% AoE take damage
rows.reason_zh: 一次传送仍可对落点范围内的所有敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: attack_slow.base: [50]→[70]
rows.reason_zh: 减攻速数值从50提高到70，装备仍会降低敌方攻速。

rows.quote: Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.
rows.reason_zh: 主动使用仍会将装备者传送到指定地点。

rows.quote: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.
rows.reason_zh: 对自己施放时仍会朝己方泉水方向传送，符合自身位移定义。

rows.quote: movement_slow.base: [50]→[35]
rows.reason_zh: 移动减速数值降至35，仍会降低敌方移速。

rows.quote: then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.
rows.reason_zh: 每次斩击的伤害和斩击次数虽有调整，一次施法仍可伤害所选方向上的多个敌人。

rows.quote: Pangolier dashes along the target line
rows.reason_zh: 石鳞剑士仍会沿指定路线冲刺。

rows.quote: briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction
rows.reason_zh: 斩击仍会短暂降低所选方向上敌人的移速。

rows.quote: Pangolier dashes along the target line
rows.reason_zh: 两版的冲刺描述相同，本次改动涉及斩击伤害、次数和物品效力，沿用原有的地形通行判定。

rows.quote: grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs %absorb_amount% damage.
rows.reason_zh: 价格调整后，主动效果仍为友方目标提供吸收物理伤害的护盾。

rows.quote: Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.
rows.reason_zh: 装备魔晶时，幻影刺客击杀英雄仍会推进其他技能的冷却。

rows.quote: active_movespeed_bonus.base: [9.5]→[12]
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能的移速加成提高到12，自身加速仍成立。

rows.quote: causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍可使幻影刺客隐身，新增的攻击解除条件只影响隐身何时结束。

rows.quote: disjointing incoming projectiles
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍可使已经飞来的弹道落空。
变更字段只有闪避数值，没有 IsBreakable 变更，沿用可被破坏的原判。
各级闪避数值均下调，但仍全部大于零。

rows.quote: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.
rows.reason_zh: 两版说明均只描述传送和攻速，且没有充能字段变更，沿用基础技能具有充能的原判。

rows.quote: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy
rows.reason_zh: 幻影刺客仍可将自身传送至所选单位。

rows.quote: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy
rows.reason_zh: 传送目标可选敌方单位，符合单体指向定义。

rows.quote: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage
rows.reason_zh: 基础短匕的伤害仍作用于一个敌方单位，未增加对周围敌人的伤害。

rows.quote: Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.
rows.reason_zh: 短匕飞行途中及命中时仍提供所在位置周围的视野。

rows.quote: slowing the enemy unit's movement speed
rows.reason_zh: 短匕仍会降低敌方目标的移动速度。

rows.quote: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed
rows.reason_zh: 短匕仍以一个敌方单位为施法目标。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍会施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: along with two additional doppelgangers.
rows.reason_zh: 重新出现时仍会额外制造两个幻象。

rows.quote: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
rows.reason_zh: 施放该技能仍可躲避弹道。

rows.quote: Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location
rows.reason_zh: 幻影长矛手本体会在目标区域内的随机位置重新出现，仍属于自身位移。

rows.quote: Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
rows.reason_zh: 单位重新出现时仍会摧毁附近的树木。

rows.quote: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself.
rows.reason_zh: 普通攻击仍有概率额外生成幻象，攻击触发的效果仍在。

rows.quote: illusion_duration.base: [8]→[7]
rows.reason_zh: 改动仅涉及幻象持续时间和魔晶主动技能冷却，没有 IsBreakable 变更，沿用可被破坏的原判。

rows.quote: His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
rows.reason_zh: 装备魔晶后，主动技能提供的隐身仍会提高自身移速。

rows.quote: while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶主动技能仍会在使本体隐身时制造幻象。

rows.quote: creating an illusion of himself.
rows.reason_zh: 本体攻击仍有概率制造自身幻象，持续时间从8秒缩短至7秒。

rows.quote: Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶主动技能仍可使幻影长矛手隐身。
